name: mcp-google-multi
description: Multi-account Google Workspace MCP server: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and more, with discover-first tools and deny-by-default write-control.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: From a Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 client (Desktop app type). Use the setup prompt for step-by-step help creating one.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: The secret paired with the client ID above. Stored in your OS keychain, never in plaintext.

master_key.title: Token encryption key (MASTER_KEY)
master_key.description: A base64 32-byte key that encrypts your stored Google tokens at rest. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32 — and keep it safe, since losing it means re-authenticating every account.

google_profile.title: Write profile
google_profile.description: Which mutations the server may perform: read-only (default, no writes), safe-writes (create/update, no permanent deletes or sends), or full-writes.
